items:
A work permit must be issued 
 and the qualified maintenance staff should be carry the
 Suitable safety category,

Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear your safety 
 and healthy equipments safety helmet, safety shoes
 . etc

Never
 perform any work on the transformer before isolating the fire protection
 system.

You
 must carry portable fire extinguisher when entering the transformer room
 after the fire.

Vent
 the flooded transformer room before entering it after the fire.

Any
 person inside the transformer room must immediately leave it after hearing
 the fire alarm.

Any
 doors leading to the room must be kept closed.

To
 prevent the accidental discharge of the system, do not touch the pilot
 cylinder weighing device inside the transformer room.

sections.text:
Note: You must perform a mechanical/manual test of the tripping
circuit. In order to prevent any CO2 discharge to the water storage
tank you must carry out step 1 and step 2 very carefully

items:
At the CO2 cylinder
 installation, secure the CO2cylinder valve head with a locking
 pin

Disconnect the tie-rods from the
 saw- toothed slide by removing the connecting pins

At the deluge valve stations,
 remove the glass from the manual pull-station Pull the handle

Observe the operation of the
 electromechanical triggers at the deluge valve station and that the CO2
 cylinders have correctly released the operating weights. Reset all stations
 for normal operation

At the CO2 cylinder
 station, move the saw-toothed slide on the trigger so the releasing system
 is in its original or starting position.

At the deluge valve station, lift
 up the operating lever of the deluge valve in order to put the valve in the
 closed position. Make sure that the weight is properly attached to the
 trigger box.

Check all CO2 spray
 nozzles, ensure they are not obstructed (plugged). This can be done by
 inserting a thin nail in each nozzle

Lightly lubricate all moving
 parts and bearing points of the mechanical trigger mechanism with a thin
 coating of grease.

text:
Fire 
 Fighting System
Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the Inspection checks I1 which must be performed every
 six months as indicated by M6 in the title block
Safety
Precautions
A work permit must be issued 
 and the qualified maintenance staff should be carry the
 Suitable safety category,
Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety 
 and healthy equipments safety helmet, safety shoes
 . etc
Transformer outage is required.
Never
 perform any work on the transformer before isolating the fire protection
 system.
You
 must carry portable fire extinguisher when entering the transformer room
 after the fire.
Vent
 the flooded transformer room before entering it after the fire.
Any
 person inside the transformer room must immediately leave it after hearing
 the fire alarm.
Any
 doors leading to the room must be kept closed.
To
 prevent the accidental discharge of the system, do not touch the pilot
 cylinder weighing device inside the transformer room.
Tools 
and Equipment
Safety Helmet, Safety Shoes.
Work to be Carried out
Note: You must perform a mechanical/manual test of the tripping
circuit. In order to prevent any CO2 discharge to the water storage
tank you must carry out step 1 and step 2 very carefully
At the CO2 cylinder
 installation, secure the CO2cylinder valve head with a locking
 pin
Disconnect the tie-rods from the
 saw- toothed slide by removing the connecting pins
At the deluge valve stations,
 remove the glass from the manual pull-station Pull the handle
Observe the operation of the
 electromechanical triggers at the deluge valve station and that the CO2
 cylinders have correctly released the operating weights. Reset all stations
 for normal operation
At the CO2 cylinder
 station, move the saw-toothed slide on the trigger so the releasing system
 is in its original or starting position.
At the deluge valve station, lift
 up the operating lever of the deluge valve in order to put the valve in the
 closed position. Make sure that the weight is properly attached to the
 trigger box.
Check all CO2 spray
 nozzles, ensure they are not obstructed (plugged). This can be done by
 inserting a thin nail in each nozzle
Lightly lubricate all moving
 parts and bearing points of the mechanical trigger mechanism with a thin
 coating of grease.
